programme.title: Transfert
programme.desc: L'ex-CIA est déterminée à comprendre ce qui est arrivé à son mari, grièvement blessé lors d'une mission.

programme.title: Clones: The Recreator Chronicles
programme.desc: Des adolescents font face à des duplicatas supérieurs d'eux-mêmes qui menacent de les remplacer.

programme.title: Stripes (1981)
programme.desc: Lorsque John Winger (Bill Murray) perd son travail, sa voiture, son appartement et sa petite amie dans la même journée, il décide qu'il n'a qu'une solution : se porter volontaire pour l'armée. Et il persuade son ami Russell (Harold Ramis) à s'engager avec lui. Ils ont bien réfléchi et l'armée n'est-elle pas le lieu idéal pour défendre les valeurs du monde démocratique...

programme.title: L'an 1 : Des Debuts Difficiles
programme.desc: Deux "chasseurs-cueilleurs" feignants sont bannis de leur village natal. Ils se lancent alors dans une odyssée à travers un monde primitif.

programme.title: L'ecole Paternelle 2
programme.desc: Après avoir connu un beau succès avec leur garderie, Charlie Hinton et Phil Ryerson emmènent cette fois leurs fils au grand air, pour un été en pleine nature au camp Driftwood, là où eux-mêmes allaient autrefois. Mais sur place, le camp se révèle complètement en ruines.

programme.title: Spanglish
programme.desc: John Clasky (Adam Sandler) est un père dévoué dont les talents de chef ont permis à sa famille (Téa Leoni, Cloris Leachman) de vivre une vie de luxe. Ils possèdent une villa d'été à Malibu, dont s'occupe la magnifique gouvernante, Flor (Paz Vega), qui a quitté le Mexique pour immigrer à Los Angeles afin d'offrir une meilleure vie à sa remarquable fille, Cristina (Shelbie Bruce), qui embrasse très vite ce nouveau style de vie américain.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Allez les filles!
programme.desc: La manager d'un “café des sports formes incluses” au bord de l'autoroute consacre tout son optimisme et sa foi à ses serveuses, ses clients et à elle-même, au cours d'une longue et étrange journée durant laquelle sa patience est mise à l'épreuve.

programme.title: Une affaire de coeur
programme.desc: Audrey Woods et Daniel Rafferty, deux avocats réputés en droit du divorce ont vu au fil des procès l'amour tourner au vinaigre. Pourrait-il en être autrement pour eux ? Au sommet de leur carrière, tout les oppose.

programme.title: Black/White
programme.desc: Theresa ramène son fiancé Simon Green à la maison, pour le 25e anniversaire de mariage de ses parents, mais elle a oublié de mentionner un détail : il est blanc. Bien déterminé à mettre fin aux fiançailles de sa fille, Percy Jones va prouver qu'un père n'a pas toujours raison.

programme.title: Shanghaï Joe
programme.desc: Un immigrant chinois, récemment arrivé en Amérique, se bat pour libérer des esclaves mexicains de leur cruel maître.

programme.title: Le salaire de la haine
programme.desc: Ken veut obtenir justice pour son frère Bill, qui a été tué par un tireur notoire nommé Stevens pour une carte de mine d'or.

programme.title: Les compagnons de la gloire
programme.desc: Un marchand d'armes suédois et un ouvrier agricole mexicain s'associent pour sauver le chef du mouvement révolutionnaire et vivent de nombreuses mésaventures.

programme.title: Ben et Charlie
programme.desc: Deux bandits sympathiques tentent de gagner leur vie dans le Far West.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Un officier de cavalerie sympathisant des Sioux organise une rencontre entre Sitting Bull et le président Grant, mais un agent indien met à l'épreuve la patience des Sioux.

programme.title: Au-delà de la haine
programme.desc: Une famille de pionniers est presque entièrement détruite par des Indiens en quête de vengeance : Le petit George est laissé évanoui sur le sol, et sa petite sœur adoptée par le chef indien. Le destin les réunira à nouveau.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: Buckaroo ne pardonne pas
programme.desc: Dans l'Ouest sauvage, Buckaroo, un mystérieux pistolero, arrive dans une ville minée par la corruption et la violence. Engagé malgré lui dans un conflit entre un puissant propriétaire terrien et un groupe de fermiers opprimés, il décide de prendre les armes pour rétablir la justice. Entre duels impitoyables, trahisons et quête de vengeance, Buckaroo devra affronter son propre passé pour faire triompher la loi du plus fort… ou celle du plus juste.

programme.title: Showtime
programme.desc: Pendant la nuit de la plus grande finale sportive de l'année, deux filles travaillant dans une station-service vivent d'étranges incidents. S'agit-il simplement de farces mises en scène ou d'une intention plus agressive ?

programme.title: Heartless
programme.desc: Jamie Morgan, un jeune homme portant une grande tache de naissance en forme de cœur sur le visage, découvre qu'il y a des démons dans les rues de l'est de Londres.

programme.title: Dreamcatcher
programme.desc: Deux soeurs et leurs amis se retrouvent retranchées dans un tourbillon de violence de 48 heures après une expérience traumatisante lors d'un festival de musique underground.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: Un groupe d'amis part en week-end à la campagne, mais découvre qu'un chasseur local leur pose problème. Ceci dit, cela n'est rien face à l'invasion extraterrestre qui menace la Terre.

programme.title: La Saison des requins
programme.desc: Trois kayakistes luttent pour leur vie lorsqu'un grand requin blanc les piège sur une petite île en train de sombrer.

programme.title: Firefall
programme.desc: Depuis son poste spatial, Arabov observe en secret sa fille restée sur Terre, incapable de couper le lien qui les unit malgré la distance cosmique.

programme.title: Eden Log
programme.desc: Un homme reprend conscience au fin fond d'une grotte.Tolbiac n'a pas la moindre idée des raisons qui l'ont amené jusque-là, pas plus qu'il ne sait ce qui est arrivé à l'homme dont il découvre le cadavre à côté de lui.

programme.title: Paysage à la main invisible
programme.desc: Plusieurs années après une occupation extraterrestre bienveillante, l'humanité s'adapte encore à ses nouveaux maîtres. Leur technologie promettait initialement une prospérité mondiale, mais elle a rendu la plupart des emplois humains — et les revenus stables — obsolètes.

programme.title: Les Prédateurs La Rivière de la rédemption
programme.desc: La chaine 100% science-fiction et fantastique. Zone réservée aux fans de films et séries SF : catastrophes, zombies, extraterrestres, paranormal, space opéras, vampires, mondes perdus et créatures mutantes sont au programme

programme.title: Helix Mère

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.desc: The Canadian ice roads exist only for a few months in the winter when the ice is thick enough. The only time of the year when goods can be transported up to Northern Manitoba. A risky trip in icy temperatures, sometimes even below - 60 degrees Celcius. programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind
programme.sub-title: In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world's largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama
programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. programme.title: The Atlantic North
programme.desc: From the reedy areas in the Basque Country, via the fantastic world of the Cantabrian mountain range, to Galicia with its spectacular coasts: This is the North Spanish wilderness, which offers unheard of diversity and reveals a hitherto completely unknown side of Spain. In the wetlands during the rutting season, red deer carry out their bitter power struggles until the water around them appears to blister and boil. The Cantabrian mountain range is habitat for around 140 Cantabrian brown bears – Western Europe's greatest bear population. The females wander from place to place in search of food. Adult male bears and steep mountain slopes are a permanent danger for the youngsters. Iridescent blue throats, defending their territorial borders against rivals, appear to observe them. Above the timberline is the Kingdom of the Cantabrian chamois. They share their habitat with the colourful wallcreeper - an extremely rare bird of the tall mountain region. The Asturian fire salamander is the only one of its kind with a complete yellow hue - he hunts his prey on the banks of the countless streams that flow into the Atlantic, which is inhabited by giants from sperm whales to basking sharks, the world's second largest fish. The rugged north has shaped the identity of its inhabitants. The film accompanies a mountain farmer in the Picos de Europa National Park, who still operates traditional livestock farming and a goose barnacle collector on the Costa da Morte, who quite possibly has the world's most dangerous job. Common to both is the fact that neither of them would exchange their homeland for life in the city.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: In the Middle Ages, the horrifying murder of Archbishop Thomas Becket of Canterbury led thousands of pilgrims to the south of England. Centuries later, the long-forgotten Pilgrims' Way is now enjoying a revival. The Pilgrim´s Way leads east to west cross-country from Winchester to Canterbury through the counties of Hampshire, Surrey and Kent. Along the way, modern pilgrims discover traces of the past and the pristine beauty of the land. They meet people who want to preserve England's rich natural treasures and traditions for the future.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: In honour of the Archangel Michael, thousands of medieval Christians set off on pilgrimages to the famous mountain monastery of the Mont-Saint-Michel in the Atlantic Ocean. Today it continues to enchant millions of visitors each year. But the pilgrimage route from Rouen to the mountain abbey seems to have been forgotten: it leads through the depths of Normandy into rural France. Modern pilgrims can expect a fascinating voyage of discovery along historic paths that will allow them to discover not only the original character of the country and its inhabitants, but also themselves.

programme.title: Europe's Forgotten Pilgrim Routes
programme.desc: For centuries, pilgrims have set off on the Via Francigena in the hopes of reaching the tombs of the apostles Peter and Paul in Rome. The ancient pilgrimage route leads through the imposing Alps to the Great St Bernard Pass and from there cross-country through Italy: along the Aosta Valley and the endless rice fields of the Po Valley, over the mountains of the Apennines, and the rolling hills of Tuscany to Lazio – en route, modern pilgrims discover Italy's majestic and diverse landscapes, as well as traces of bygone eras. Along the way, they meet people who share with them their enthusiasm for the country and the tradition of pilgrimage.

Sashi takes an inside look into how the city's most popular restaurant, Masque does their signature 8 hands collaborative event. With Prateek and his star studded guest chefs, Matt Orlando from Copenhagen and Ivan Brehm from Nouri in Singapore the trio head to Delhi for an ingredients scoring mission. programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs

Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Hamare
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: Beti Hamari Anmol
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Duniyadari

Also covered: PoK election disruptions, Sheikh Hasina's first public address since ouster, and Japan-US joint intervention to prop up the yen.

programme.title: Kharcha Pani
programme.desc: State-run oil companies reported combined losses of ₹18,149 crore for the June quarter—far lower than the government's ₹75,000 crore estimate . In this episode of Kharcha Pani, Shruti breaks down the gap, India's Russian oil imports, and SEBI's new stock market rules.

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: Prashant Kishor's victory in Bankipur is being seen as a political earthquake that goes far beyond a single by-election. Coming after the Gen Z protests at Jantar Mantar, the result has delivered a strong message to the BJP, RJD, and Bihar's political establishment.

programme.title: Sansad Mein Aaj
programme.desc: In today's Sansad Mein Aaj, we cover the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill passed in the Lok Sabha without debate, the ₹47,100 collected by Samajwadi Party MPs from their donation box protest, Priyanka Gandhi's protest over lathi-charge on students, and the MSME Amendment Bill passed in the Rajya Sabha amid opposition uproar and Kharge's argument with the Chairman.

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: In today's Sehat show, we cover monsoon eye infections, excessive hair fall during the rainy season, and the roti vs rice debate for blood sugar control. Experts Dr. Mayank Tomar, Dr. Govind Bhartiya, and Dr. Abhinav Kumar Gupta join us with practical tips.

programme.title: The Cinema Show
programme.desc: In today's The Cinema Show, we cover the passing of Sopranos actor Vincent Pastore, Spider-Man: Brand New Day's historic ₹306 crore first-week collection, and the ₹50 crore music rights deal of Shah Rukh Khan's King. Plus, updates on Mirzapur: The Movie, Akshay Kumar's R.D. Burman biopic, and much more.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: Former WFI chief Brij Bhushan Sharan Singh and Vinod Tomar have been acquitted by Delhi's Rouse Avenue Court in the sexual harassment case filed by women wrestlers . Vinesh Phogat and Bajrang Punia have expressed disappointment and announced plans to challenge the verdict in a higher court .

programme.title: Cinema Adda

They discuss their characters, the film's unique story, and how Punjabi cinema is evolving with new genres.

programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.title: The new Mercedes-Benz GLC AMG Line World Premiere Teaser
programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

A complicare la situazione ci penseranno una guardia notturna e una cameriera che rischieranno di finire nei guai.

Di questa comitiva fanno parte la famiglia De Angelis, composta da padre, madre e figlia con il relativo fidanzato, e due giovanotti, amici inseparabili.

Il carabiniere Bartolomucci vuole sposare in segreto la sua fidanzata visto che il regolamento accademico gli proibisce di farlo prima di aver compiuto 15 anni di servizio. Ma proprio alla vigilia delle nozze, qualcuno gli ruba il cavallo. Nel giorno del suo matrimonio, il carabiniere farà di tutto per trovarlo. Diretta da Carlo Lizzani.

programme.title: I ragazzi dei Parioli
programme.desc: Una storia sui giovani della classe borghese italiana degli anni Sessanta e sui loro modi di impiegare il tempo.

Costretta dall`autorità del padre, Aida induce Radames a rivelare il segreto delle future mosse dell`esercito egiziano.

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: Matrimonio all'italiana
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata domestica e amante del ricco Domenico, Filumena, fingendosi in punto di morte, riesce a farsi sposare. L`inganno però viene scoperto e Domenico è risoluto a sciogliere il matrimonio, ma Filumena non si arrende e cos gli rivela di avere tre figli, uno dei quali suo...

programme.title: Vita da cani

Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Animali selvatici
programme.desc: Matthias, dopo un litigio, scappa dalla Germania e torna al villaggio d'origine in Transilvania. Qui trova una situazione complicata.

programme.title: Di là dal Fiume

Tedo appartiene alla generazione che è stata costretta allo sfollamento di massa a causa della guerra civile in Abkhazia, uno dei luoghi più belli della Georgia. La guerra civile ha portato via tutto ciò che aveva Tedo, anche la speranza. Il film racconta uno straordinario dramma interiore di un bambino, i suoi pensieri, sentimenti, passioni, dolori e sforzi per prendere le armi contro le difficoltà.

Qui cresce e matura, tra le mille difficoltà di Sarbojaya che da sola deve mantenerlo a causa della scomparsa del coniuge Harithar. Dopo aver fatto ritorno nella vecchia casa Apu, oramai maturo e consapevole del suo destino, decide di intraprendere la via dello studio che lo porterà a frequentare l'università a Calcutta. Mentre si trova nella metropoli indiana le condizioni di salute della madre si aggravano: tardivo si rivelerà il suo viaggio verso la casa materna, per salutare il genitore un'ultima volta.

programme.title: I Toni dell'Amore

programme.title: The Illusionist
programme.desc: Vienna, seconda metà dell'Ottocento. L' acclamato illusionista Eisenheim incanta le platee con i suoi incredibili trucchi. Ha persino catturato l' interesse del Principe Leopoldo e della sua fidanzata Sophia, un tempo legata sentimentalmente allo stesso Eisenheim.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All'inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: La casa del diavolo
programme.desc: Sequel del sanguinoso 'La casa dei mille corpi', la psicotica famiglia Firefly vaga senza meta, lasciando sulla strada una scia di morte e distruzione. È, però, braccata da uno sceriffo feroce e due cacciatori di taglie senza scrupoli: la caccia sarà spietata.

programme.title: Halloween The Beginning
programme.desc: Il feroce assassino Michael Meyers viene rilasciato dall'istituto psichiatrico in cui è stato rinchiuso per 17 anni e si scatena alla ricerca della sorella minore. Questo significa solo una cosa: nessuno è al sicuro!

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

programme.title: La baia di Eva
programme.desc: Nel caldo sud della Louisiana degli anni ‘60, la giovane Eve Batiste scopre gli oscuri segreti della sua famiglia benestante. Dopo aver assistito a un tradimento del padre, il carismatico dottor Louis Batiste, la sua innocenza si sgretola tra verità scomode e superstizioni. Un dramma avvolto da mistero e magia, dove il confine tra ricordi e realtà si fa sempre più labile.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: La storia della regina Elisabetta I, da quando era una giovane principessa poco più che ventenne fino alla sua morte nel 1603. Una donna che giurò di non sposarsi mai, mettendo sempre al primo posto il suo amore per l'Inghilterra a quello per un uomo. Storia e politica si intrecciano in un racconto realistico della storica monarca della Casa dei Tudor.

programme.title: The Virgin Queen
programme.desc: La storia della regina Elisabetta I, da quando era una giovane principessa poco più che ventenne fino alla sua morte nel 1603. Una donna che giurò di non sposarsi mai, mettendo sempre al primo posto il suo amore per l'Inghilterra a quello per un uomo. Storia e politica si intrecciano in un racconto realistico della storica monarca della Casa dei Tudor.

programme.title: La verità vi prego sull'amore
programme.desc: Un grande romanti-cult del nostro cinema, il film che ha rivelato alcuni tra i suoi talenti: Pierfancesco Favino, Carlotta Natoli, Elda Alvigini e Gabriella Passion. Il San Valentino più romantico e divertente della vostra vita: Monica ama Lorenzo ma Lorenzo ama Olga, Olga ama Luca e tutti si ritrovano il giorno di San Valentino a casa di Elisabetta e Michelangelo che stanno insieme (per ora).

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: Un'ex stella del football universitario con il cuore spezzato si lascia coinvolgere in un pericoloso sport fiorentino e in un'affascinante donna del posto.

programme.title: Un killer nel campus
programme.desc: Cassie è entusiasta quando il suo trasferimento di metà anno in una confraternita d'élite viene accettato, con tanto di alloggio gratuito, assistenza scolastica e una grande rete di ex alunni. Tuttavia, quando Cassie scopre che la presidentessa e la consigliera del gruppo gestiscono un servizio di escort con le ragazze della confraternita, capisce che questo piccolo segreto potrebbe ucciderla...

programme.title: L'amore in città
programme.desc: Emma viene mandata dal suo capo in una piccola città. Dopo essersi scontrata con l'affascinante Riley, figlio del sindaco, Emma fa di tutto per dargli una lezione e veste i panni del suo capo.

programme.title: First response
programme.desc: Dopo una rapina andata per il verso sbagliato, Camilla, paramedico con molta esperienza alle spalle, e il collega Gerry vengo dirottati e costretti a prestare aiuto al fratello del killer gravemente ferito.

programme.title: Early Release
programme.desc: Dopo aver scontato la sua pena, Taylor Reynolds fatica a ricostruire la sua vita e a riacquistare la fiducia della sua famiglia. Ma quando una pericolosa ex-compagna di cella riemerge con un'agenda nascosta, Taylor deve affrontare il suo passato per proteggere tutto ciò che ama.

programme.title: Dopo l'uragano
programme.desc: La vita di un giovanissimo cuoco viene travolta dall'arrivo dell'uragano Sandy nel 2012.

programme.title: Il diario dell'amore
programme.desc: Henry e Penny vivono a New Orleans e sono una coppia molto affettuosa, fino a quando la tragedia colpisce.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Sotto Il Cielo Delle Hawaii
programme.desc: Un famoso militare professionista ritorna sul luogo dei suoi più grandi trionfi legati al programma spaziale degli Stati Uniti a Honolulu, Hawaii. Qui incontra una sua ex, ma altrettanto inaspettatamente si innamora della giovane pilota dell'Air Force a lui assegnata.

programme.title: Love Is in the Air: Turbolenze d'amore
programme.desc: Antoine, un avvocato che vive a New York, è sul volo che lo riporta in Francia per un colloquio di lavoro. Si ritrova seduto accanto a Julie, sua ex fidanzata. Si sono lasciati alcuni anni prima a causa di un malinteso. Non si erano più visti da allora e Julie ce l'ha ancora a morte con lui.

programme.title: Boulevard
programme.desc: Un matrimonio lungo una vita, una vita di bugie. Nolan Mack vicino alla pensione e riceve una promozione quale premio per il suo costante impegno nel lavoro. A un marito devoto, intrappolato in un matrimonio di convenienza, fino a quando incontra per strada un giovane... e

programme.title: Josie
programme.desc: Hank gestisce un motel in una tranquilla città del Sud. La sua vita solitaria viene sconvolta dall'arrivo di Josie, una studentessa del liceo bionda e sensuale, con cui stringe amicizia. Ma quando il passato della ragazza viene alla luce, si manifestano anche le sue reali intenzioni.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The whistleblower
programme.desc: Katryn Bolkovac, poliziotta del Nebraska divorziata e con una figlia adolescente affidata al marito, decide di fare richiesta per una missione dell'Onu in Bosnia. Siamo nel 1999 e le forze di pace controllano il territorio con l'aiuto di contractors della società britannica Democra.

programme.title: The Sparrow
programme.desc: Quando l'adolescente e pecora nera della famiglia Kevin provoca accidentalmente la morte del fratello maggiore Robbie, fa qualcosa di imperdonabile: tiene segreta la tragedia. Kevin deve guardare con orrore mentre le conseguenze della sua bugia prendono corpo.

programme.title: Come salvare il Natale
programme.desc: Megan usa le settimane che precedono ogni Natale per aiutare gli altri. Chiamata a salvare la festa di Natale della sua cittadina, la ragazza si ritrova contesa tra l'uomo dei suoi sogni e il partner ideale.

programme.title: Un ballo per Natale
programme.desc: L'insegnante di danza classica OLIVIA (30 anni) ottiene più di quanto si aspettasse quando sceglie la talentuosa LILY (8 anni) come protagonista nel recital di Natale de Lo Schiaccianoci, e si ritrova a innamorarsi del bellissimo padre pompiere di Lily, MICHAEL (30 anni)

programme.title: La mappa dellamore
programme.desc: Una giornalista che sta per lanciare un'app di appuntamenti ha il compito di scrivere una mappa dei luoghi più romantici della Florida. L'unico problema è che deve lavorare con una guida turistica i cui gusti sono opposti ai suoi.

programme.title: The Californians
programme.desc: In una versione di 'Le bostoniane' di Henry James, una battaglia infuria tra due fratelli. Gavin, uno scaltro imprenditore, e sua sorella Olive, un'ambientalista risoluta. Ma una straordinaria cantante, Zoe, si interpone tra i due.

programme.title: La signora di Purity Falls
programme.desc: Una vedova si trasferisce a Purity Falls ma il rapporto con suo figlio si deteriora presto.

programme.title: Un amore sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Una pattinatrice incontra un pescatore che le dimostra che c'è molto più della semplice competizione.

programme.title: Live is life. 80... e tanta voglia di rock
programme.desc: Un musicista condannato a lavorare in una casa di riposo decide di formare un gruppo rock con gli anziani.

programme.title: Un amore sul ghiaccio
programme.desc: Una pattinatrice incontra un pescatore che le dimostra che c'è molto più della semplice competizione.

programme.title: Non ti posso dimenticare
programme.desc: Fred Astaire impersona un eroico pilota della seconda guerra mondiale innamorato di una dattilografa la quale, ignara del suo valore, lo disprezza credendolo un imboscato. Alla fine la donna scoprirà la verità.

programme.title: Ricomincio Da Te
programme.desc: La trentenne Daphe ha appena chiuso una relazione. A una festa incontra due uomini affascinanti e opposti: con entrambi avvia una relazione.

programme.title: Party Girl
programme.desc: Angélique ha 60 anni. Ama ancora le feste, le piacciono ancora gli uomini. Di notte, per guadagnarsi da vivere, gli fa bere in un night club nei pressi del confine con la Germania. Con il passare del tempo, i clienti diventano sempre piu' rari. Ma Michel, suo cliente fisso, è ancora innamorato di lei. Un giorno, chiede a Angélique di sposarlo.

programme.title: I Corti di WeShort
programme.desc: The Last Architect: Nell'anno 2446, la Terra è completamente ricoperta di edifici. Nova, l'ultimo architetto, non ha più un lavoro, ma vince un concorso che le cambierà la vita. A Date with Mr Mappleton: Una cena romantica si trasforma in un incubo quando i souvenir preziosi della casa, gelosi della proprietaria, iniziano ad attaccare l'invitato. Tentatrice: Myrtille è disperatamente attratta dal cantante del cabaret. Una notte, il potere di un profumo particolare le dà la possibilità di uscire dall'ombra... 100.000 Acres of Pine: La ranger Megan Patel deve scoprire il mistero della morte del fratello. Ma seguendo le sue tracce, Megan scopre un'oscurità alla quale potrebbe non essere in grado di sfuggire. Haircut: Un'insegnante e il suo studente si trattengono in un'aula vuota. Attraverso sguardi e gesti, inizia uno strano confronto. Juliet: In un futuro non troppo lontano, la società SEED lancia con successo sul mercato Juliet, un androide da compagnia di prima generazione. La tecnologia continua così la sua avanzata e modelli sempre nuovi arrivano nei negozi ma allo stesso l'umanità ha sempre più difficoltà a trovare il proprio spazio..

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Tra il bullismo a scuola, le angherie del suo prepotente capo alla sala giochi locale e il dover badare al fratello minore, alla sorella e alla madre maniaco-depressiva, la vita di Sarah Taylor non è facile. Mentre il suo amore per la commedia cresce e la vetrina si avvicina, il delicato equilibrio della sua vita diventa sempre più difficile da mantenere...

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: L'invidia Del Mio Migliore Amico
programme.desc: L'equilibrio fra Tim (Ben Stiller) e Nick (Jack Black), amici, vicini e colleghi, si rompe quando una delle idee strampalate di Nick, il Vapoorizer, uno spray che fa evaporare i bisogni dei cani, ha successo. Tim, che aveva deriso l'idea di Nick e rinunciato all'opportunità di entrare nell'affare, adesso può solo restare a guardare mentre la sua invidia e la fortuna di Nick crescono di egual misura.

programme.title: Selvaggi in fuga
programme.desc: Ricky, un ragazzino di città, viene dato in affido a una famiglia di campagna della Nuova Zelanda. Si sente subito a casa con la nuova famiglia affidataria: la zia Bella, l'irascibile zio Hec e il cane Tupac. A seguito di un drammatico avvenimento, Ricky rischia di essere spedito in un'altra casa. Ciò spingerà il ragazzino ed Hec a fuggire nei boschi. Con la caccia all'uomo che ne consegue, i due sono costretti a mettere da parte le loro divergenze e a collaborare per sopravvivere.

programme.title: Dick
programme.desc: Le liceali Betsy Jobs (Kirsten Dunst) e Arlene Lorenzo (Michelle Williams) si allontanano durante una gita scolastica alla Casa Bianca e incontrano il presidente Nixon (Dan Hedaya). Finiscono per diventare le dog sitter ufficiali del suo cane, Checkers, e le consigliere segrete di Tricky Dick durante lo scandalo Watergate.

programme.title: Il Campeggio Dei Papà
programme.desc: Cuba Gooding Jr. e Paul Rae star sono Charlie Hinton e Phil Ryerson, due padri che tentano di gestire il loro campeggio estivo, nonostante la loro situazione economica precaria. Per migliorare tale situazione e tenere sotto controllo un gruppo di ragazzini disubbidienti, Hinton è costretto a chiedere l'aiuto del padre colonnello (Richard Gant) con cui non è in buoni rapporti.

programme.title: Aragosta a colazione
programme.desc: Enrico fallisce il suicidio e finisce nei guai recitando la parte del marito per un amico

programme.title: La governante
programme.desc: La nuova governante francese Caterina Leher sconvolge la famiglia Platania, portando caos e tragedie

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Il fidanzamento
programme.desc: La madre di Mirella vuole che Luigi sposi sua figlia, ma lui non vuole rinunciare al ruolo di fidanzato.

programme.title: Freak Show
programme.desc: La storia dell'adolescente Billy Bloom, che decide di candidarsi come reginetta del ballo nonostante la sua scuola ultra conservatrice.

programme.title: First Daughter
programme.desc: La figlia del presidente va al college, ma i pericoli del suo titolo la seguono.

programme.title: La programmazione riprenderà a breve
programme.desc: Ci stiamo concedendo un sonno riparatore per tornare più belli di prima! Resta sintonizzato e presto arriveranno altre proposte straordinarie di intrattenimento a cura di Rakuten TV.

programme.title: Tutto a posto e niente in ordine
programme.desc: Un gruppo di meridionali, immigrati a Milano, affittano un appartamento. Gino, dopo vari sforzi per cercare un lavoro onesto, si dà alla malavita. Carletto diventa cuoco, Biky e Adelina fanno le cameriere, Isotta finisce su un marciapiede. Sante, un siciliano, in breve diventa padre di sette figli.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: Una madre single della classe operaia, viene assunta per pulire lo yacht di lusso di Leonardo, un playboy ricco, egoista e viziato. Dopo aver licenziato ingiustamente Kate e averle rifiutato il pagamento, Leonardo cade in mare durante una festa troppo sfrenata e si risveglia sulla costa dell'Oregon.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Alaska
programme.desc: Un californiano insoddisfatto accoglie con gioia la notizia di un'eredità che lo attende in Alaska. Ma per impadronirsene deve purtroppo affrontare una prova molto dura.

programme.title: Lillo e Greg: The Movie
programme.desc: Una collezione antologica delle migliori scenette comiche firmate da Lillo e Greg, in compagnia di tanti famosi colleghi. Un concentrato di ironia e musica dai tratti surreali e farseschi.

programme.title: La miliardaria
programme.desc: Epifania ha ereditato da suo padre una fortuna favolosa e un consiglio sul tipo di uomo da sposare. Lei, invece, si sposa senza seguire il consiglio di suo padre, ma il matrimonio si rivela un fallimento.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Avventuriero
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte e imprese eroiche, un audace avventuriero affronta duelli e complotti in un viaggio ricco di azione e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell'Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: Afrodite, dea dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: L'assedio di Siracusa
programme.desc: Tra assedi, strategie e passioni, Siracusa resiste all'avanzata romana in una sfida che decide il destino della città. Con Sylva Koscina.

programme.title: Una pistola per cento croci!
programme.desc: Dopo che un irlandese viene ucciso nel West, suo figlio Jimmy cerca vendetta ma viene ucciso a sua volta. Django (o Sartana) scopre la verità tramite una lettera della sorella di Jimmy, Jessica, e parte alla ricerca degli assassini. Tra rapimenti, torture e scontri, Django cerca giustizia, giustificando le cento croci sulla sua pistola.

programme.title: Killer, adios
programme.desc: Un giovane torna nella sua città natale dieci anni dopo aver ucciso l'assassino dei suoi genitori. Una volta lì, gli viene chiesto di aiutare lo sceriffo.

programme.title: I due volti della vendetta
programme.desc: Dopo aver rapinato una banca messicana, papà Longworth prende il bottino e lascia il suo compagno Rio per essere catturato ma Rio fugge e cerca papà in California.

programme.title: Nato Per Uccidere
programme.desc: Roose arriva in una città dove uno spietato barone terriero sta cercando di prendere il controllo dell'intera area, decidendo alla fine di schierarsi con gli abitanti della città.

programme.title: I tre spietati
programme.desc: Dopo l'omicidio del padre durante un furto di cavalli, i tre figli pianificano vendetta vent'anni dopo.

programme.title: 100.000 dollari per Lassiter
programme.desc: Martin è sfruttato dai banditi finché Lassiter non gli rivela il nascondiglio di colui che lo ha reso storpio.

programme.title: ...e poi lo chiamarono il Magnifico
programme.desc: Joe, che non ama la violenza, affronta il selvaggio West per esaudire l'ultimo desiderio del padre.

programme.title: Indio Black, sai che ti dico: Sei un gran figlio di…
programme.desc: Durante la rivoluzione messicana, il pistolero Sabata trama per rubare oro da un colonnello austriaco.

programme.title: La Rivincita dei Supereroi
programme.desc: Da Batman a Black Panther: la storia dei supereroi che hanno conquistato il cinema.
